output.explanation: Checked the pinned checkout without modifying it. The central tree now follows actual ownership: App -> MappingWorkspacePage -> CanvasWorkspace -> CanvasSession -> MappingDocumentController. Four peripheral diagrams elaborate controller state/history, mounted surfaces, backend producers/review, and persistence. Arrows distinguish calls and subscriptions from containment. Source corrections: App creates the injected history and storage services; the editor runtime belongs to the mounted canvas, not the session; GenerationCanvasBridge is shared backend wiring, not owned by AgentChatService; change acceptance checks proposal version, live document/name equality and published revision expectations, rather than only live version numbers. Verified against MappingPage.tsx, canvasWorkspace.ts, canvasSession.ts, mappingDocumentController.ts, MappingEditorCanvas.tsx, canvasHistoryService.ts, workspacePersistence.ts, bootstrap.ts and changeSessionService.ts. Backend services shown as peers are constructed together and communicate through injected dependencies, not falsely nested beneath their callers.

|   |       |-- CanvasWorkspace: session lifetime owner
|   |       |   |-- Draft metadata, controller registry, subscriptions, dirty index
|   |       |   |-- setDrafts(): create sessions; dispose replaced/removed sessions
|   |       |   `-- CanvasSession (one per draft)
|   |       |       |-- Read-only document/presentation/selection/control/geometry stores
|   |       |       |-- Saved baseline and dirty/undo status
|   |       |       |-- cursorCopy: pending pasted content
|   |       |       `-- MappingDocumentController: semantic command boundary
|   |       |           |-- ControllerSnapshot: document, canvas state and version
|   |       |           |-- Editing-context handle -> shared history service
|   |       |           |-- Optional editor-driver attachment (not editor ownership)
|   |       |           |-- applyUpdate/select/commitDocument/canvasView/layout commands
|   |       |           |   `-- Validate/reconcile -> history append when recorded
|   |       |           `-- Notify stores; checkpoint change -> session.onCommit
|   |       |-- WorkspacePersistence: subscriptions and per-session delta cursors
|   |       |   `-- workspace.onPersist + view changes -> record batches
|   |       |-- SourcePaneViewState: per-document/pane scroll and cameras
|   |       |-- PromptComposerCoordinator: drafts, references, retries and polling
|   |       |   `-- DiagramEditClient -> backend agent service
|   |       |-- DiagramRevisionReceiver / CanvasViewReceiver: receive results
|   |       |-- useAgentCanvasBridge: register, poll, execute, reply, unregister
|   |       |   `-- Received mutations -> workspace controllers
|   |       |-- Mounted canvas/source/review surfaces
|   |       |   `-- Read session stores; dispatch commands to controllers
|   |       |-- Copy/move and linked undo/redo coordination

|   |       `-- Save/reload/publication coordination
|   |           `-- Publish captured checkpoint -> MappingDiagramService
|   `-- EvalsPage: separate /evals surface
`-- createBackend (src/server/app/bootstrap.ts)
    |-- Agent, chat, change-review and evaluation services
    |-- Workspace records and published-catalog services
    `-- Source access and compaction services

|   |   `-- Diagram views, controls, optional viewport/projection layout
|   `-- Version/checkpoint identity and geometry/status projections
|
`-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService (shared service, not a controller child)
    |-- WeakMap<CanvasEditingContext, CanvasHistory>

`-- CanvasViewControls / GeneratedCanvases / CanvasViewDiffPreview

createBackend: agent, review and source service wiring

|-- LiveCanvasService

|-- AgentContextService / AgentContextLibrary

|-- AgentChatService

|-- SelectionService / LocalChatService

|-- ChangeSessionService
|   |-- Private history service and per-session serialization queues

|   |-- Proposal edit -> headless MappingDocumentController

|       `-- projectCatalogs.acceptCanvasChanges() -> published acceptance
|-- DiffSessionWorkflowService / PushIntegrationService
|   `-- Repository hunks + canvases -> ChangeSessionService proposals
|-- CompareSessionService / ComparisonGenerationService

|-- EvalRunService
|   |-- Prepared inputs, running tasks and result writes
|   |-- LayoutTemplateService / ReferenceGenerationService
|   `-- JudgementService / ExperimentService
|-- EvalPromptService / EvalReferenceService / GeneratedCanvasCatalog

|-- ProjectSourceService

`-- HTTP routes and dispose(): stop tasks, runtimes, bridges and language service

Workspace persistence versus published representations
|
|-- WorkspacePersistence (owned by MappingWorkspacePage)
|   |-- Session cursors, subscriptions, known drafts and workspace index state
|   |-- Controller.persistenceChanges() + metadata/baseline -> record changes
|   |-- SourcePaneViewState.captureDisplay/captureCamera -> view records
|   |-- Active document + cross-canvas transfers -> workspace index
|   `-- Deduplicated batches -> WorkspaceStorage.records
|-- WorkspaceStorage (App-injected; page can create a fallback)
|   |-- RecordStorage: local records, batches and flush
|   `-- One lazily created storage worker per opened workspace
|       `-- Load/write/restore -> /api/mapping/workspace/records
|
`-- createBackend: durable service wiring
    |-- MappingWorkspaceService
    |   |-- Project-scoped loadRecords/applyBatch/portableExport/prepareImport
    |   `-- Calls injected MappingWorkspaceStore
    |-- MappingWorkspaceStore
    |   `-- WorkspaceRecordStore: durable workspace UI/history records
    |-- MappingDiagramService
    |   |-- Initialize/save/publishCheckpoint/delete
    |   `-- Uses catalog and captured workspace checkpoints for publication
    `-- DiagramStore / projectCatalogs / DiagramPersistence
        |-- Durable representation catalogs and diagram revisions
        |-- acceptCanvasChanges(): version-checked proposal publication
        `-- Workspace UI persistence does not itself publish representation revisions
